transcript.note: Round 1. Built a lock table from hvSegs first (V segment => column frozen, H segment => row frozen), so every point below moves only on its free axis or is fully free. Criterion 1 (take H/V when reachable in +/-3), 15 closures: 77->(53,0)+95->(53,14) meet on column 53 (V, dx was 4 so split 3/1 between the two free ends); 91->(53,43) puts it on 100's row (H) while keeping column 53 for the V chain 5-26-91; 68->(56,46) drops onto column 56 between 7(56,44) and 64(56,55) and closes BOTH 7-68 and 68-64 into V in one move, the single best point on the map; 48->(61,69) onto 81's column (V); 89->(39,45) onto 97's row (H) - the alternative (33,45) would have given a second V with 30 but the edge would have run through vertex 2(33,58), so I took the single gain; 42->(38,73) onto 29's column (V); 28->(49,53) onto 29's row (H); 32->(41,44) onto 52's row (H) - going to column 38 instead would have put 32 on top of the existing 52-102 V edge; 74->(52,37) onto 24's row (H), keeping column 52 for 83-74; 37->(73,43) onto 40's row (H), keeping column 73 for 78-37-11; 86->(65,39) onto 75's row (H), keeping column 65 for 86-40; 19->(48,31) onto 18's column (V), keeping row 31 for 31-19-83, and it incidentally turns 19-71 into a 45; 79->(38,31)+35->(38,20) build a vertical spine on column 38 (35-79-53-55-102-52), +2 V. Criterion 4 respected throughout: no move changes a coordinate that an already-aligned segment depends on. Also three setup moves that gain nothing this round but put a free leaf within reach for round 2: 38->(19,49) heading for column 21 (39), 56->(3,102) heading for column 6 (92), 21->(58,84) heading for column 61 (48). Checked winding order by hand at every degree>=3 point that moved or whose neighbour moved (0,7,11,19,23,24,26,29,30,31,32,34,37,40,52,53,65,68,74,75,79,81,83,86,87,89,91,100,102) and checked that no new segment swallows an intermediate vertex on the shared row/column.
